== Published English Original Virtual Set 2 wording ==
Both texts permit looking at the Reserve Deck’s top card during your control phase. If the card is revealed, the early text allows placement and the later text directs placement. The same three piles are available. The named phase and singular action retain the period One Rule. The Undercover instruction uses the original set’s deployment indicator in both printings.
